title: Whispering Peaks Library
description: A secluded mountain library surrounded by overgrown gardens, tended by three caretakers who preserve both books and the silence.

places.name: Whispering Peaks Library
places.description: A stone library nestled into the mountainside, filled with ancient tomes and warm reading corners.

places.name: Memory Garden
places.description: A wild garden with carved stone paths, blooming alpine flowers, and quiet benches.

places.name: Silent Atrium
places.description: A small entrance hall with a cracked bell, coat pegs, and a visitor log.

actors.name: Mara
actors.goal: Keep the library’s catalog intact and the garden paths clear.

actors.name: Otis
actors.goal: Nurture the garden’s rare alpine plants and stonework.

actors.name: Lina
actors.goal: Restore damaged books and catalog new donations.

memories.text: The bell in the atrium used to ring when a traveler arrived; it has been silent for years.
The garden’s oldest rose bush blooms only when a new book is cataloged.
A donation arrived last spring wrapped in a map of the lower valleys.

rules.description: Voices stay soft indoors; the mountain echoes everything.
All visitors sign the atrium logbook before entering the stacks.
Tools are shared, but each caretaker returns them to the garden shed by dusk.
